- `lib/response.js:352`: `res.jsonp` ends with `return this.send(body)`.
- `lib/response.js:376`: `res.sendStatus` ends with `return this.send(body)`.
- `lib/response.js:1044`: `res.render` calls `self.send(str)` inside its default callback, so the call is credited to `render`.
- `lib/router/index.js:655`: `sendOptionsResponse` calls `res.send(body)`.
